name: Peeled Baby Turnips (Boiled Tender with Sea Salt)
whyItWorks: Delicate white baby turnips peeled and gently simmered in chicken stock until translucent and tender. Mild flavor without the harsh sulfur bite of mature raw roots.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim greens, peel skin completely, quarter roots, and boil in chicken broth for 15 minutes until knife pierces without resistance.
